A FabriChat room's program as a room set up from it stores it: the import
closure of `packages/patterns/fabrichat/room.tsx` at commit 560bcd9f20 of this
repository, each module under its path below `packages/patterns/` at that
commit, with `.txt` appended. A room set up from it stores a message write
policy naming four writers, and a writer claim at `messages/windows`.

`fabrichat-four-writer-room-update.test.ts` stores these modules in a space as
the room's source and sets the room up from them. Each file holds the bytes of
its blob exactly, since a module's identity is the hash of its bytes, so none
of them may be edited, reformatted, or regenerated from another commit.
